description: This file contains functions for processing, translating, and handling documentation files with frontmatter and body sections, including reading, parsing, translating, and writing back files with metadata and content.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Main function that processes a documentation file: reads, splits frontmatter and body, translates, overlays changes, and writes output.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document string with specific start/end tags.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses a tagged document string into frontmatter and body parts, ensuring proper tags and structure.

methods.name: trimTagNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing newlines from a string.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Constructs a template string for frontmatter fields and generates markers for translation replacement.

methods.name: markerPair
methods.description: Generates start/end marker strings for frontmatter fields, using specific formatting with field name and index.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Updates the frontmatter data map with translated values based on markers.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts the value enclosed by specific start and end markers within a string.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Updates or extends the 'read_when' array in frontmatter data to set a specific index to a new value.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Determines if processing can be skipped by comparing stored hash with the current file hash.

methods.name: extractSourceHash
methods.description: Retrieves the source hash value from frontmatter metadata if available.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves an absolute path and relative path of a file within the documentation root, with validation.
